summary: Production-ready Fleet.io multiplayer .io game architecture and incremental 4-phase implementation plan: (1) Server-authoritative Node.js + Colyseus room engine with 10-20 players per room, anti-cheat validation, and reconnection tokens; (2) Client-side prediction and snapshot interpolation preserving existing 60fps canvas gameplay and controls; (3) Agar/Starblast .io Plasma Energy Orbs, automatic ship tier evolution (Scout -> Hunter -> Heavy Frigate), and live Top-10 Mass Leaderboard; (4) Cosmetic-only Hangar Store (skins, exhaust trail colors, shield aura styles), simulated non-combat Rewarded Ad bonus, PWA installability, and multiplayer automated verification tests.
